sections.h2: Per point of volatility, the franc still offers the largest rate gap

chart.title: Sterling offers the least rate gap for each point of volatility
chart.sub: Gap against India divided by INR volatility; a simple ratio, not a formal risk-adjusted return.

sections.means: On this rough ratio the franc leads and sterling trails, so the ranking depends on how much volatility a borrower will carry.
